The '''Enaleh system''' was located in the [[Southern Core]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It contained the terrestrial [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Enaleh]]. Enaleh was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[hela]], a [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Snake/Legends|serpentine]] [[Amphibian/Legends|amphibians]] that used a biologically generated [[repulsorlift field]] to float through Enaleh's [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]]. Occasionally, helas were exported offworld; however, the creatures were a rare sight on other planets overall.<ref name="Creatures" />

The Enaleh [[Star system/Legends|system]] fell within the borders of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Pius Dea Era]], a period of [[Time/Legends|time]] that lasted between [[12,000 BBY/Legends|12,000 BBY]] and [[11,000 BBY]]. During that era, Enaleh served as an [[Ordnance/Regional Depot/Legends|Ordnance/Regional Depot]] [[Colonist/Legends|outpost]] for the Republic and was known as Ord Enaleh.<ref name="EGTW" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Enaleh system was introduced via an illustration of Enaleh in the [[1994]] sourcebook ''[[Creatures of the Galaxy]]'', published by [[West End Games]] for ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''. The section of the book describing the planet was authored by [[Chuck Truett]] and illustrated by [[David Plunkett]].<ref name="Creatures" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' first identified the Enaleh system and placed it in grid square L-13.<ref name="TEA" />
